flagged.evidence: The page says, “a triad with empty incoming boundary must begin with a 0-handle.” The scoped handle-decomposition definition allows the empty list and says that with empty incoming boundary it presents the empty manifold; the empty product triad is also allowed. Thus the empty triad has no first handle. The claim needs a nonempty-triad hypothesis, as the example item itself includes.

The proof says, “Every handle body of this presentation is the same subset of W as in any other presentation.” Handle bodies are not canonical subsets across presentations. For example, a disk relative to empty incoming boundary has a one-0-handle presentation and also a presentation with a 0-handle, a 1-handle forming an annulus, and a 2-handle capping one boundary circle. Duality identifies the selected presentation with its dual; it does not identify its handle bodies with those of every other presentation.

The ACω paraphrase contains “indexed by > ℕ” and “such that > f(n)∈X_n”. The cited current definition says “indexed by ℕ” and “such that f(n)∈X_n”; the stray greater-than signs make the stated formulation ill-formed.
